Here’s a few tips for my migraines/ headache sufferers :

If you’re not up to reading something lengthy, feel free to screenshot / save this for later ! I understand if you guys are not able to read right now! 🧡🧡

Drink lots and lots of water ! 
I drink 1 cup as soon as I wake up as your body loses a lot of fluid while you sleep.
I try to drink at least 2 Litres everyday as this is the best to prevent dehydration but being a busy college student, I sometimes forget lmao.

I do take Ibuprofen and paracetamol which only slightly dulls the pain 🤷🏻‍♀️

I’ve listened to headache relief videos for a couple years now, suffered with migraines since I was 10.
I wouldn’t say they help cure headaches but it gives me something to focus on so I can sleep which in turn cures my headache.
Sleep really is the best cure. 

I listen to relaxing sleep music every night and specifically headache relief when I’m very tense / stressed.

Also TEA or caffeine! That’s been the best discovery I’ve ever come across, 1 cup of tea helps sooth my pain an incredible amount! 
(I’m actually lactose intolerant which also gives me headaches so I always make sure anything I eat / drink is dairy free or lactose free) 
I must add that if you drink caffeine regularly, this may actually be your trigger, caffeine addiction can be a huge trigger for migraines! 
But only drinking it when you have a migraine is fine and caffeine doesn’t work for everyone but I’m lucky it does for me 8/10 times 

Always remember that things like Cola, Fanta, sprite, mostly all of your common sodas have additives, caffeine, LOTS OF SUGAR, these may be playing a part as to why you’re getting migraines, try minimising your soda intake and replace with water ! 🧡

If you do suffer, I’d start recording what you eat and start seeing if anything you eat causes them. 
I found out by doing mine that : chocolate, tuna, dairy, orange juice, vinegar, garlic, large amounts of sugar and other things trigger my headaches.
Cheese is the worst for me, that’s also how I found out I was lactose intolerant.
Basically anything with a really strong flavour is a trigger for me 🙄

Keep lights off or to a minimum as headaches are really light sensitive and also remove glasses / hair ties or anything which might be pulling on your head, specifically your temples. 
Glasses sit directly on your temples so I always take them off when I have a headache. 

I’ve been able to sleep sitting up / hunched over since I was a baby so that’s really helpful for headaches too, I find laying down makes mine worse, I think that may have something to do with blood flow ??? I’m not sure. 
If you can sleep with your head propped up, that might help ? 

Massages are so underrated, I massage my temples, forehead and neck, I also sometimes massage behind my ears and that seems to help a little too ! 

Get a cold, damp flannel / towel / cold compress and place it over your temples, forehead and eyes and close them and stay relaxed and calm.
Staying cool in general and not getting too hot is key ! 

I also use a product called “tiger balm” 
(MAKE SURE ITS THE WHITE VERSION AND NOT RED, THE WHITE VERSION IS SPECIFICALLY FOR HEADACHES AND MUSCLE PAIN) if you can’t get that, menthol rubs also do a similar job.(vick's menthol rub)
Massage it into your temples (firm enough to actually get down into the temple but not too firm otherwise it'll hurt more) and on your forehead and you should start feeling relief.


I suffer from anxiety as well so when I get really stressed out, I have the most crippling migraine ever, I’m down for like 3 days, making sure you manage your stress levels is really important.

If your headaches are persistent even after following advice, please, please see a GP as it may be a sign of something more serious, be safe ! 🧡
Remember to stay calm and that this pain won’t last forever, you got this🧡
